bookmark.status: Safety-critical location recording for mutual aid

M.M3_hierarchy_path: Product Manager > Help > Requests > Location Recording

IO3_transformations.operation: Record both parties GPS coordinates at 60s intervals from accept to resolution

DW2_downstream_pipeline.description: Location logs available for safety review

P.P1_bottleneck_analysis: Battery drain from continuous GPS. Storage for high-frequency location data.
P.P2_defensibility: 60s interval balances safety record quality with battery impact. Encrypted at rest.
P.P5_backup_plan: Fall back to cell-tower location if GPS unavailable. Log gaps in recording.
P.P6_backup_plan_test: Simulate failure scenario in staging with mock data
P.P7_testing_strategy: Test with simulated GPS in staging. Test battery impact over 4h continuous recording. Test consent revocation mid-session.
P.P8_benchmarks: 60s recording interval. <5% battery impact per hour. <10m accuracy.

L.L1_legal_considerations: Critical privacy feature. Location data encrypted at rest with per-request keys. Auto-delete after 90 days unless dispute filed.
L.L3_consent_requirements: Explicit consent prompt before first help accept. Re-consent annually.
L.L4_liability_notes: Location recording protects both parties. Beacon stores but does not monitor in real-time.

F.F1_cost_considerations: Storage: ~1KB per location point. ~1440 points per day per user pair. Negligible cost.
F.F2_accounting_considerations: Allocated to help module operational budget

S.S1_cybersecurity: Per-request encryption keys. AES-256 at rest. Only accessible by the two parties and admin with cause.
S.S2_data_privacy: Exact location stored (not granularity-reduced). This is intentional for safety.
S.S4_access_control: Two parties + admin with documented cause.
S.S5_audit_requirements: Access log for every location log query. Retention audit at 90 days.

X.X2_open_questions: Define dispute hold policy that extends retention
